name: The Backrooms Is In The Eye Of The Beholder
source:
Before Romance The Backrooms' events, Glarence & Adiel traveled together, just the two of them.  One night, before they rest, Adiel asks Glarence a curious question.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/the-backrooms-is-in-the-eye-of-the-beholder]itch.io[/url]]

在Romance The Backroom活动之前，Glarence和Adiel一起旅行，只有他们两个人。一天晚上，在他们休息之前，阿迪尔问了格拉伦斯一个奇怪的问题。
